fields.name: Vanilla & Strawberry
fields.description: Summer in a can. Creamy vanilla meets juicy strawberry for a combo so good, you'll forget it's not homemade.

fields.name: Chocolate & Caramel
fields.description: Dark, rich chocolate wrapped in golden caramel. One sip and you're done. No apologies.

fields.name: Salted Caramel & Pretzel
fields.description: Sweet. Salty. Smooth. This one doesn't play by the rules and that's exactly why we love it.

fields.name: Pistachio & Cream
fields.description: Fancy? Yes. Worth it? Absolutely. Smooth pistachio cream that hits different every single time.

fields.name: Banana & Peanut Butter
fields.description: Thick, creamy, dangerously addictive. Peanut butter so thick, banana so ripe. This one hits hard and you will not see it coming.

fields.name: Red Velvet
fields.description: Cake in a can. Bold, velvety and unapologetically extra. You deserve this one.

fields.name: Vanilla & Marshmallow
fields.description: Cloud in a can. Soft vanilla with fluffy marshmallow, like a hug you can drink.

fields.name: Mint & Chocolate Chip
fields.description: Fresh, cool and packed with chocolate chips. Like a breeze on a hot day, but way more delicious.
